cards.card_text: God says no partiality to the poor and no favoritism to the rich.
cards.verse_text: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
cards.snippet: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge…

cards.card_text: Moses tells the judges to show no partiality and hear small and great alike.
cards.verse_text: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike.
cards.snippet: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike.

cards.card_text: Here's why, Moses says: "For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe." Friend, I can't even bribe my own oven to bake faster.
cards.verse_text: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
cards.snippet: …and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.

cards.card_text: Then Moses says: don't deny justice, don't show partiality and don't accept a bribe.
cards.verse_text: Do not deny justice or show partiality.
cards.snippet: Do not deny justice or show partiality.

cards.card_text: With the LORD there is no partiality or bribery The LORD will remove any judge who turns aside The LORD keeps a record of every judgment
cards.verse_text: Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
cards.snippet: …do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”

cards.card_text: Then Job asks if they'll speak wickedly on God's behalf, or show Him partiality.
cards.verse_text: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
cards.snippet: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?

cards.card_text: True or false: Job says God would rebuke them for secretly showing partiality.
cards.verse_text: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
cards.snippet: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.

cards.card_text: Proverbs 18:5 says showing partiality to the wicked is not good.
cards.verse_text: Showing partiality to the wicked is not good, nor is depriving the innocent of justice.
cards.snippet: Showing partiality to the wicked is not good, nor is depriving the innocent of…

cards.verse_text: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
cards.snippet: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece…

cards.verse_text: “So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.”
cards.snippet: …the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.”
